```{r, echo=FALSE}
glimpse(bank_data_raw)

# Convert all factor variables and -1 pdays to 0 for not previously contacted

    pdays = ifelse(pdays == -1, 0, pdays),
    across(c(job, marital, education, default, housing, loan,
             contact, day, month, poutcome, y), as.factor),
    across(c(campaign, pdays, previous), as.ordered)
```

# **Preprocessing Considerations**
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10
# Spilt data
set.seed(622)
trainIndex = createDataPartition(bank_data_raw$y, p=0.7, list=FALSE)
bd_train = bank_data_raw[trainIndex, ]
bd_test = bank_data_raw[-trainIndex, ]

# Rebalance data, oversampling of target variable "yes"
bd_train = ovun.sample(y ~ .,
                       data = bd_train,
                       method = "over",
                       seed = 622)$data

# Overview of training data
table(bd_train$y) # no=27946   yes=27828
summary(bd_train)
plot_histogram(bd_train)
plot_qq(bd_train, by='y')
plot_boxplot(bd_train, by='y')
plot_bar(bd_train)
```
# **Feature Engineering**
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Feature Engineering

# Add column of age group and balance group
# Step 1: Define balance breaks points
bbreaks_100 = seq(0, 900, by=100) # 0 to 900 in 100s
bbreaks_1000 = seq(1000, 5000, by=1000) # 1000 to 5000 in 1000s

# Combine all breaks
balance_breaks = c(-Inf, bbreaks_100, bbreaks_1000, Inf)

# Step 2: Auto-generate labels
balance_labels = c("Negative",
                   paste0(bbreaks_100, "-", bbreaks_100 + 99),
                   paste0(bbreaks_1000[-length(bbreaks_1000)], "-", 
                          bbreaks_1000[-1] - 1),
                   "5000+")

# Step 3: Apply
feature_engineer = function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      duration_min = duration / 60,
      age_group = cut(
        age,
        breaks = c(18, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 100),
        labels = c("18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
      ),
      balance_group = cut(
        balance,
        breaks = balance_breaks,
        labels = balance_labels,
        include.lowest = TRUE
      ),
      indebt = factor(
        ifelse(balance < 0, 1, 0),
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("Not in Debt", "In Debt")
      )
    )
}

bd_train = feature_engineer(bd_train)
bd_test = feature_engineer(bd_test)

summary(bd_train)
plot_histogram(bd_train)
plot_qq(bd_train, by='y')
plot_boxplot(bd_train, by='y')
plot_bar(bd_train)
```
# **Experimentation and Model Training**
```{r Decision Tree 1, echo=FALSE}
# Selected variable sets
sv1 = c("age", "job", "balance", "month", "duration", "contact", "campaign", "y")
sv2 = c("age_group", "balance_group","duration_min", "contact", "y")

# Create dataframe for the selected sets for model experimentation
bd_train_sv1 = bd_train[, sv1]
bd_train_sv2 = bd_train[, sv2]

# Decision Tree #1 
# Create task
task1 = TaskClassif$new(
  id = "dt1",
  backend = bd_train_sv1,
  target = "y"
)

# Define learner
learner_tree1 = lrn("classif.rpart", predict_type = "prob")

# Define hyperparameter search space
search_space_tree1 = ps(
  cp = p_dbl(lower = 0.001, upper = 0.1),
  minsplit = p_int(lower = 2, upper = 20),
  maxdepth = p_int(lower = 3, upper = 10)
)

# Set resampling method
resampling = rsmp("repeated_cv", folds = 5)

# Tuning Instance
instance_tree1 = TuningInstanceSingleCrit$new(
  task = task1,
  learner = learner_tree1,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_space_tree1,
  terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 100)
)

# Create tuner
tuner = tnr("random_search")

# Optimize
tuner$optimize(instance_tree1)
  
# Train final model with best params
learner_tree1$predict_type = "prob"
learner_tree1$param_set$values = instance_tree1$results_learner_param_vals
learner_tree1$train(task1)

# After training
importance1 = learner_tree1$model$variable.importance
print(importance1)

# Visualize the trained decision tree
rpart.plot(learner_tree1$model, type = 2, extra = 104, fallen.leaves = TRUE, main = "Decision Tree 1")


# Test with bd_test (unseen data)

# Select the same features from bd_test as used in training
bd_test_sv1 = bd_test[, sv1]

# Create task for test data with those features
task_test1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "test_task", backend = bd_test_sv1, target = "y")

# Predict on test task
prediction1 = learner_tree1$predict(task_test1)

# Evaluate performance on test data
print(prediction1$confusion)

# Evaluate multiple performance metrics
measures = list(
  msr("classif.acc"),
  msr("classif.precision"),
  msr("classif.recall"),
  msr("classif.fbeta", beta = 1),
  msr("classif.auc") # For binary classification only
)

prediction1$score(measures)

# ROC curve for plotting
# Get probability predictions for "positive" class
roc_data_dt1 = data.frame(
  truth = prediction1$truth,
  prob = prediction1$prob[, "yes"],  # or use prediction1$prob("yes") if using latest mlr3 version
  model = "Decision Tree 1"
)

# all_roc_data = bind_rows(roc_data_dt1, roc_data_rf, roc_data_ada) You can repeat this for other models (e.g., random forest, adaboost), then combine them

# Plot ROC
roc_obj1 = roc(roc_data_dt1$truth, roc_data_dt1$prob, levels = c("no", "yes"), direction = "<")
plot(roc_obj1, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - Decision Tree 1")
```

```{r Random Forest 1, echo=FALSE}
# Create classification task
task_rf1 = TaskClassif$new(
  id = "rf1",
  backend = bd_train_sv1,
  target = "y"
)

# Define learner
learner_rf1 = lrn("classif.ranger", 
                  num.trees = 50, 
                  predict_type = "prob",
                  importance = "impurity",
                  write.forest = TRUE) # needed to extract trees

# Define hyperparameter search space
search_space_rf1 = ps(
  mtry = p_int (lower = 2, upper = 6),
  min.node.size = p_int(lower = 1, upper = 10)
)

# Tuning instance
instance_rf1 = TuningInstanceSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_rf1,
  learner = learner_rf1,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr ("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_space_rf1,
  terminator = trm ("evals", n_evals = 20)
)

# Run tuning
tuner$optimize(instance_rf1)

# Train final model with best hyperparameters
learner_rf1$param_set$values = instance_rf1$result_learner_param_vals
learner_rf1$train(task_rf1)

# Variable importance
importance_rf1 = learner_rf1$model$variable.importance
print(importance_rf1)

# --- Train a separate decision tree just for visualization (not used for prediction)
rf1_model = rpart(y ~., data = as.data.frame(bd_train_sv1),
                  method = "class")

# Plot the decision tree for interpretability
rpart.plot(rf1_model, type = 4, extra = 104, 
           main = "Example Decision Tree 4 (for interpretation only)")
printcp(rf1_model)


# Test on unseen test set

# Subset test set with the same features
bd_test_sv1 = bd_test[, sv1]

# Create task for test set
task_test_rf1 = TaskClassif$new(
  id = "test_rf1",
  backend = bd_test_sv1,
  target = "y"
)

# Predict on test set
prediction_rf1 = learner_rf1$predict(task_test_rf1)

# Confusion matrix
print(prediction_rf1$confusion)

# Evaluate multiple metrics
prediction_rf1$score(measures)

# Get probability for positive class "yes"
roc_data_rf1 = data.frame(
  truth = prediction_rf1$truth,
  prob = prediction_rf1$prob[, "yes"],
  model = "Random Forest 1"
)

# Plot ROC
roc_obj_rf1 = roc(roc_data_rf1$truth, roc_data_rf1$prob, levels = c("no", "yes"), direction = "<")
plot(roc_obj_rf1, col = "forestgreen", main = "ROC Curve - Random Forest 1")
```

```{r AdaBoost 1, echo=FALSE}
# Prepare bd_train_sv1
bd_train_sv1$y = as.factor(bd_train_sv1$y)
X1 = bd_train_sv1[, setdiff(names(bd_train_sv1), "y")]
y1 = bd_train_sv1$y
X1_encoded = model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X1)
bd_train_encoded1 = data.frame(X1_encoded, y = y1)

task_boost1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "ada_xgb_sv1", backend = bd_train_encoded1, target = "y", positive = "yes")

learner1 = lrn("classif.xgboost", predict_type = "prob")

search_space1 = ps(
  nrounds = p_int(lower = 20, upper = 60),
  max_depth = p_int(lower = 1, upper = 2),
  eta = p_dbl(lower = 0.5, upper = 1.0)
)

resampling1 = rsmp("cv", folds = 3)

instance1 = TuningInstanceSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_boost1,
  learner = learner1,
  resampling = resampling1,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_space1,
  terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 20)
)

tuner1 = tnr("random_search")
tuner1$optimize(instance1)

learner1$param_set$values = instance1$result_learner_param_vals
learner1$train(task_boost1)

booster1 = learner1$model
importance_matrix1 = xgb.importance(model = booster1)
print(importance_matrix1)
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix1, top_n = 10, main = "AdaBoost-style XGBoost 1 Variable Importance")

# Test prediction for sv1
bd_test_sv1$y = as.factor(bd_test_sv1$y)
X_test1 = bd_test_sv1[, setdiff(names(bd_test_sv1), "y")]
y_test1 = bd_test_sv1$y
X_test_encoded1 = model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X_test1)
bd_test_encoded1 = data.frame(X_test_encoded1, y = y_test1)
task_test1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "test_ada_xgb_sv1", backend = bd_test_encoded1, target = "y", positive = "yes")
prediction_ada1 = learner1$predict(task_test1)

print(prediction_ada1$confusion)
print(prediction_ada1$score(measures))

roc_data1 = data.frame(truth = prediction_ada1$truth, prob = prediction_ada1$prob[, "yes"])
roc_obj1 = roc(roc_data1$truth, roc_data1$prob, levels = c("no", "yes"), direction = "<")
plot(roc_obj1, col = "red", main = "ROC Curve - AdaBoost-style XGBoost 1")
```

```{r SVM1, echo=FALSE}
# Selected variable sets
sv1 = c("age", "job", "balance", "month", "duration", "contact", "campaign", "y")
sv4 = c("age", "job", "balance", "month", "contact", "campaign", "y")

# Create dataframe for the selected sets for model experimentation
bd_train_sv1 = bd_train[, sv1]
bd_train_sv4 = bd_train[, sv4]

# Select the same features from bd_test as used in training
bd_test_sv1 = bd_test[, sv1]

# Create task for test data with those features
task_test1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "test_task", backend = bd_test_sv1, target = "y")

#  Data Preparation
# Convert categorical variables to dummy (numeric) features
bd_train_sv1 = data.frame(model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = bd_train_sv1))
bd_test_sv1  = data.frame(model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = bd_test_sv1))
bd_train_sv1$y = bd_train$y
bd_test_sv1$y  = bd_test$y

# Standardize numeric columns
num_cols = sapply(bd_train_sv1, is.numeric)
scaler = scale(bd_train_sv1[, num_cols])
bd_train_sv1[, num_cols] = scaler
bd_test_sv1[, num_cols] = scale(
  bd_test_sv1[, num_cols],
  center = attr(scaler, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(scaler, "scaled:scale")
)

# Convert to data.table for mlr3 efficiency
setDT(bd_train_sv1)
setDT(bd_test_sv1)

# Create Tasks
task_svm1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_task", backend = bd_train_sv1, target = "y")

# Subsample for tuning (30% of training data)
set.seed(123)
idx1 = sample(nrow(bd_train_sv1), size = 0.1 * nrow(bd_train_sv1))
bd_train_sub1 = bd_train_sv1[idx1, ]
task_svm_sub1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_tune", backend = bd_train_sub1, target = "y")

# Shared Tuning Settings
resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 3)
terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 10)
tuner = tnr("random_search")

# RBF Kernel
learner_rbf = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "radial", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_rbf = ps(cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5), gamma = p_dbl(0.001, 0.1))

instance_rbf1 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub1,
  learner = learner_rbf,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_rbf,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_rbf1)
learner_rbf$param_set$values = instance_rbf1$result_learner_param_vals
learner_rbf$train(task_svm1)

# Linear Kernel
learner_linear = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "linear", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_linear = ps(cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5))

instance_linear1 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub1,
  learner = learner_linear,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_linear,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_linear1)
learner_linear$param_set$values = instance_linear1$result_learner_param_vals
learner_linear$train(task_svm1)

# Polynomial Kernel
learner_poly = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "polynomial", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_poly = ps(
  cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5),
  degree = p_int(2, 4),
  gamma = p_dbl(0.001, 0.1),
  coef0 = p_dbl(0, 1)
)

instance_poly1 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub1,
  learner = learner_poly,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_poly,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_poly)
learner_poly$param_set$values = instance_poly1$result_learner_param_vals
learner_poly$train(task_svm1)

# Evaluation
task_svm_test1 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_test", backend = bd_test_sv1, target = "y")

pred_rbf1   = learner_rbf$predict(task_svm_test1)
pred_linear1 = learner_linear$predict(task_svm_test1)
pred_poly1   = learner_poly$predict(task_svm_test1)

# Confusion Matrices
cat("\n Confusion Matrix - RBF Kernel SVM1:\n")
print(pred_rbf1$confusion)

cat("\n Confusion Matrix - Linear Kernel SVM1:\n")
print(pred_linear1$confusion)

cat("\n Confusion Matrix - Polynomial Kernel SVM1:\n")
print(pred_poly1$confusion)

measures1 = list(
  msr("classif.acc"),
  msr("classif.precision"),
  msr("classif.recall"),
  msr("classif.fbeta", beta = 1),
  msr("classif.auc")
)

results1 = bind_rows(
  cbind(Kernel = "RBF SVM1",    as.data.frame(t(pred_rbf1$score(measures1)))),
  cbind(Kernel = "Linear SVM1", as.data.frame(t(pred_linear1$score(measures1)))),
  cbind(Kernel = "Poly SVM1",   as.data.frame(t(pred_poly1$score(measures1))))
)

cat("\n SVM1 Kernel Comparison:\n")
print(results1)

# ROC Curves
roc_rbf1  = roc(pred_rbf1$truth,    pred_rbf1$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))
roc_lin1  = roc(pred_linear1$truth, pred_linear1$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))
roc_poly1 = roc(pred_poly1$truth,   pred_poly1$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))

# Define semi-transparent colors (alpha = 0.3)
col_rbf1  = rgb(1, 0, 0, alpha = 0.3)  # red with transparency
col_lin1 = rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.3)  # blue with transparency
col_poly1 = rgb(0, 1, 0, alpha = 0.3)  # green with transparency

# Plot ROC curves
plot(roc_rbf1,  col = col_rbf1,  lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curves - SVM1 Kernels")
plot(roc_lin1,  col = col_lin1,  lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
plot(roc_poly1, col = col_poly1, lwd = 2, add = TRUE)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("RBF", "Linear", "Polynomial"),
       col = c(col_rbf1, col_lin1, col_poly1),
       lwd = 2)
```

```{r SVM4, echo=FALSE}
# Select the same features from bd_test as used in training
bd_test_sv4 = bd_test[, sv4]

# Create task for test data with those features
task_test4 = TaskClassif$new(id = "test_task", backend = bd_test_sv4, target = "y")

# Data Preparation
# Convert categorical variables to dummy (numeric) features
bd_train_sv4 = data.frame(model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = bd_train_sv4))
bd_test_sv4  = data.frame(model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = bd_test_sv4))
bd_train_sv4$y = bd_train$y
bd_test_sv4$y  = bd_test$y

# Standardize numeric columns
num_cols = sapply(bd_train_sv4, is.numeric)
scaler = scale(bd_train_sv4[, num_cols])
bd_train_sv4[, num_cols] = scaler
bd_test_sv4[, num_cols] = scale(
  bd_test_sv4[, num_cols],
  center = attr(scaler, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(scaler, "scaled:scale")
)

# Convert to data.table for mlr3 efficiency
setDT(bd_train_sv4)
setDT(bd_test_sv4)

# Create Tasks
task_svm4 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_task", backend = bd_train_sv4, target = "y")

# Subsample for tuning (30% of training data)
set.seed(123)
idx4 = sample(nrow(bd_train_sv4), size = 0.1 * nrow(bd_train_sv4))
bd_train_sub4 = bd_train_sv4[idx4, ]
task_svm_sub4 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_tune", backend = bd_train_sub4, target = "y")

# Shared Tuning Settings
resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 3)
terminator = trm("evals", n_evals = 10)
tuner = tnr("random_search")

# RBF Kernel

learner_rbf = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "radial", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_rbf = ps(cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5), gamma = p_dbl(0.001, 0.1))

instance_rbf4 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub4,
  learner = learner_rbf,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_rbf,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_rbf4)
learner_rbf$param_set$values = instance_rbf4$result_learner_param_vals
learner_rbf$train(task_svm4)

# Linear Kernel
learner_linear = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "linear", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_linear = ps(cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5))

instance_linear4 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub4,
  learner = learner_linear,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_linear,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_linear4)
learner_linear$param_set$values = instance_linear4$result_learner_param_vals
learner_linear$train(task_svm4)

# Polynomial Kernel
learner_poly = lrn("classif.svm", kernel = "polynomial", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob")
search_poly = ps(
  cost = p_dbl(0.1, 5),
  degree = p_int(2, 4),
  gamma = p_dbl(0.001, 0.1),
  coef0 = p_dbl(0, 1)
)

instance_poly4 = TuningInstanceBatchSingleCrit$new(
  task = task_svm_sub4,
  learner = learner_poly,
  resampling = resampling,
  measure = msr("classif.auc"),
  search_space = search_poly,
  terminator = terminator
)
tuner$optimize(instance_poly4)
learner_poly$param_set$values = instance_poly4$result_learner_param_vals
learner_poly$train(task_svm4)

# Evaluation
task_svm_test4 = TaskClassif$new(id = "svm_test", backend = bd_test_sv4, target = "y")

pred_rbf4    = learner_rbf$predict(task_svm_test4)
pred_linear4 = learner_linear$predict(task_svm_test4)
pred_poly4   = learner_poly$predict(task_svm_test4)

# Confusion Matrices
cat("\n Confusion Matrix - SVM4 RBF Kernel:\n")
print(pred_rbf4$confusion)

cat("\n Confusion Matrix - SVM4 Linear Kernel:\n")
print(pred_linear4$confusion)

cat("\n Confusion Matrix - SVM4 Polynomial Kernel:\n")
print(pred_poly4$confusion)

pred_rbf4    = learner_rbf$predict(task_svm_test4)
pred_linear4 = learner_linear$predict(task_svm_test4)
pred_poly4   = learner_poly$predict(task_svm_test4)

measures4 = list(
  msr("classif.acc"),
  msr("classif.precision"),
  msr("classif.recall"),
  msr("classif.fbeta", beta = 1),
  msr("classif.auc")
)

results4 = bind_rows(
  cbind(Kernel = "RBF",    as.data.frame(t(pred_rbf4$score(measures4)))),
  cbind(Kernel = "Linear", as.data.frame(t(pred_linear4$score(measures4)))),
  cbind(Kernel = "Poly",   as.data.frame(t(pred_poly4$score(measures4))))
)

cat("\n SVM4 Kernel Comparison:\n")
print(results4)

# ROC Curves
roc_rbf4  = roc(pred_rbf4$truth,    pred_rbf4$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))
roc_lin4  = roc(pred_linear4$truth, pred_linear4$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))
roc_poly4 = roc(pred_poly4$truth,   pred_poly4$prob[, "yes"], levels = c("no", "yes"))

# Define semi-transparent colors (alpha = 0.3)
col_rbf4  = rgb(1, 0, 0, alpha = 0.3)  # red with transparency
col_lin4  = rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.3)  # blue with transparency
col_poly4 = rgb(0, 1, 0, alpha = 0.3)  # green with transparency

# Plot ROC curves
plot(roc_rbf4,  col = col_rbf4,  lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curves - SVM4 Kernels")
plot(roc_lin4,  col = col_lin4,  lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Named list of prediction objects
predictions = list(
  DT1 = prediction1,
  DT2 = prediction2,
  RF1 = prediction_rf1,
  RF2 = prediction_rf2,
  ADA1 = prediction_ada1,
  ADA2 = prediction_ada2,
  'SVM1 Linear' = pred_linear1,
  'SVM4 Linear' = pred_linear4
)

# Score each model and build a data frame with proper column names
results_list = lapply(names(predictions), function(name) {
  scores = predictions[[name]]$score(measures)
  # scores is a named numeric vector; convert to data frame with correct names
  df = as.data.frame(as.list(scores))
  df$model = name
  df
})

# Combine all rows
results_wide = bind_rows(results_list)

# Reorder columns (optional)
results_wide = results_wide |>
  select(model, everything())

# Round for readability
results_wide = results_wide |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

# Check result
print(results_wide)

# Rename columns for report use
results_wide |>
  rename(
    Accuracy = classif.acc,
    Precision = classif.precision,
    Recall = classif.recall,
    F1_Score = classif.fbeta,
    AUC = classif.auc
  )
```
